scripts.dev: PORT=3003 bun run --watch src/server.ts & cd web && bun run dev
scripts.build:release: cd web && bun run build && cd .. && bun build --compile --target=bun --outfile=fastwrite ./src/server.ts
scripts.start: cd web && bun run build && cd .. && bun run src/server.ts
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit && cd web && bunx tsc --noEmit
